generationPrompts.prompt: Create ONE transparent RGBA logo asset sheet as a precise 2-column by 2-row grid with FOUR isolated designs, no gridlines, labels, mockups, frames, background cards, glow, bevels, gradients or shadows. Each design centered within its own quadrant with large clear gutters. Top left: a horizontal full logo for white surfaces, using dark flat ink. Top right: exactly the same full logo geometry, all artwork including lettering in flat pale silver #e0e5e8, for black and red surfaces. Bottom left: only the compact emblem, dark on-light version. Bottom right: exactly the same compact emblem, flat pale silver #e0e5e8. Keep artwork off all quadrant boundaries. Transparent negative space within letters and symbols. Compact emblem must remain obvious at 32px, with broad solid strokes and open counters. No extra wording, numbers or contact details. Every quadrant contains the same dealer identity. Faithfully redraw the attached public REBOU NAJD showroom wordmark. Exact large words REBOU NAJD, smaller exact line USED CARS TR. Preserve the confident broad sans-serif lettering and cream/black identity of the sign, cleaned professionally. Top-left full wordmark is near-black #17191c on transparent. No building, Arabic duplicate line, LLC suffix, showroom number, spotlights, strings or background. Bottom-left compact mark is a new, restrained, clear RN ligature formed with two broad architectural strokes, near-black, open counters and no enclosing shield, car clipart or ornament. Right quadrants use matching flat pale silver #e0e5e8, no yellow glow, and transparent counters. This is the same lettering identity with a proposed compact companion.
